hack.protocol_name: Curve Finance (multiple pools) + JPEG'd, Alchemix, Metronome
hack.description: A hidden compiler bug in Vyper versions 0.2.15–0.3.0 silently disabled reentrancy guards in Curve's ETH pools since 2021, allowing attackers to drain $69M across four pools in a single day when the bug was finally discovered and weaponized.
